summary: The customer called to report a complete internet outage since the morning. The agent checked the system, identified an unplanned area outage with technicians currently working on it, and informed the customer that service would be restored within two hours. The call ended politely and satisfactorily.

evidence.text: المفروض الـ service ترجع خلال ساعتين زمان maximum.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Restore internet service within a maximum of two hours

evidence.text: أهلاً معك رامي، كيف بقدر أساعدك اليوم؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a polite, respectful, and professional tone throughout the interaction.

evidence.text: ولا يهمك يا أستاذ، خليني أشيك على السيستم فوراً.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent reassured the customer right away and showed understanding regarding the inconvenience.

evidence.text: حسب الـ update اللي وصلني، المفروض الـ service ترجع خلال ساعتين زمان maximum.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately identified the root cause and provided a clear resolution timeframe.

evidence.text: لا أبداً، الـ issue مش من عندك، هي عامة بالمنطقة. بس تخلص الصيانة بترجع لحالها automatically.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent explained clearly and simply that the issue was an area outage and no action was needed from the customer.

evidence.text: الله يعافيك، سداقة بخدمتك، نهارك سعيد!
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent asked if further help was needed and closed the call with appropriate pleasantries.

evidence.text: عم بشوف إنه فيه unplanned outage بمنطقتكم، والـ technicians عم بشتغلوا عليها حالياً.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The information provided about the unplanned outage and technician status matched the system check.

evidence.text: ممكن تعطيني الـ account number لو سمحت؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent followed proper procedure by asking for the account number to verify the customer before looking up details.

quote.text: عندي مشكلة بالـ internet connection، من صبح اليوم وهو مقطوع نهائياً.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: آه فهمت، طيب بتعرف تقريباً قديش رح يطول لحتى يرجع؟
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: تمام ممتاز، ما في داعي أعمل restart للـ router يعني؟
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: طيب عظيم، شكراً كتير لك ولحسن تعاونك.
quote.speaker: Customer
